summary: A fortified compound featuring a main building with distinctive horizontal striped walls and a sloped wooden roof. It is guarded by three tall watchtowers, two made of dark stone and one of red brick, surrounded by a partial perimeter wall and marked boundaries.

shape.overall_form: central striped building flanked by three tall towers

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: tower walls and horizontal wall bands

materials.name: brick
materials.role: isolated watchtower and perimeter wall base

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: white horizontal bands, vertical pillars, and perimeter markers

rebuild_hints: Lay out the footprint using the dotted white block boundary as a guide.
Construct the main building walls using alternating layers of white blocks, stone bricks, and wood planks.
Build the main roof as a single-directional slope (shed style) using wood stairs or slabs.
Erect the two dark stone watchtowers at the corners of the main building, topping them with flat wooden roofs and a central light source.
Construct the separate red brick tower on the perimeter wall with a dark nether brick roof.
uncertainties: The exact block type of the white material (could be quartz, white concrete, or wool).
The exact block type of the dark stone towers (could be cobblestone, deepslate, or a textured stonebrick).
The interior layout and floor divisions are completely hidden.
